figures.caption: Figure 1. Overview of the two data sets used in this study. Top: Data set 1 contains conformers of square-planar Ni-based rigid and flexible model structures relevant to nitrile arylation, each with one of 25 bisphosphine ligands. Bottom: Data set 2 includes octahedral Ir, Ru, and Mn complexes relevant to hydrogenation chemistry, each with one of 88 bisphosphine ligands. Details on Data set 2 are available in our previous work.22 Figure adapted from ref 22 by A.V Kalikadien, N.J. van der Lem, C. Valsecchi, L. Lefort and E.A. Pidko.
